svg.text: 64 nodes · equal normalized diameter and conductor volume · ideal DC resistor networks
Cyan: identical terminal coordinates. Amber: changed terminal placement; exploratory, not a controlled ranking.
No signal attenuation, bandwidth, fluid flow or Maxwell simulation. No performance-family promotion.
G*: mean effective conductance in V/(ρD²). Stretch: network distance / straight distance. Faults: exhaustive single-edge removals.
Equal resource policy: A=V/Σlength. Extra wire makes every edge thinner; geometric complexity can lower conductance.
